leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the container-type property to designate an element as a query container.
Construct a container query using the @container rule to target a specific container.
Configure responsive typography by adjusting font-size within a container query.
Manipulate layout properties like padding and margin based on container dimensions.
Integrate container queries with flexbox or grid to create adaptive component layouts.
Initialize a container query that modifies element colors when the container width changes.
Implement a container query to control the visibility or display of child elements.
